add_library(catboost-cuda-cpu_compatibility_helpers)

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  if(${CMAKE_VERSION} VERSION_LESS "3.17.0")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with HIP requires at least cmake 3.17.0")
  endif()

  enable_language(HIP)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -D__HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__")


  find_package(HIP REQUIRED)
  target_include_directories(catboost-cuda-cpu_compatibility_helpers PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()

target_link_libraries(catboost-cuda-cpu_compatibility_helpers PUBLIC
  contrib-libs-linux-headers
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  catboost-cuda-data
  models
  private-libs-algo
  catboost-libs-data
  catboost-libs-helpers
  catboost-libs-model
  private-libs-target
)

target_sources(catboost-cuda-cpu_compatibility_helpers PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/catboost/cuda/cpu_compatibility_helpers/model_converter.cpp
)
